description: Comprehensive question bank derived from Mensuration.pdf (SSLC level). Covers definitions, formulas, conversions, solved examples, practice questions and common examination errors. All questions are unique and mapped point-by-point to the source document.

questions.subject: Mathematics
questions.question: What is mensuration?

options.A: The branch of mathematics concerned with measuring length, perimeter, area, surface area and volume of geometrical figures
options.B: The branch of mathematics dealing only with algebraic equations
options.D: The study of probability and statistics

questions.explanation: Mensuration is the branch of mathematics concerned with measuring the length, perimeter, area, surface area and volume of geometrical figures.

questions.subject: Mathematics
questions.question: What is a 2D (two-dimensional) figure?

options.A: A solid object having length, breadth and height
options.B: A plane figure having length and breadth but no thickness

questions.explanation: A 2D figure is a plane figure having length and breadth but no thickness, such as a square, rectangle, triangle or circle.

questions.subject: Mathematics
questions.question: What is a 3D (three-dimensional) solid?

options.A: A plane figure with length and breadth only
options.C: A solid object having length, breadth and height, occupying space

questions.explanation: A 3D solid has length, breadth and height, and occupies space, such as a cube, cuboid, cylinder, cone or sphere.

questions.subject: Mathematics
questions.question: What is perimeter?

options.A: The measure of the region enclosed by a 2D boundary
options.B: The total length of the boundary of a closed two-dimensional figure
options.C: The amount of 3D space occupied by a solid
options.D: The total area of outer surfaces of a 3D solid

questions.explanation: Perimeter is the total length of the boundary of a closed two-dimensional figure.

questions.subject: Mathematics
questions.question: What is area?

options.A: The total length of the boundary of a figure
options.B: The measure of the region enclosed by a two-dimensional boundary
options.D: The sum of all edge lengths

questions.explanation: Area is the measure of the region enclosed by a two-dimensional boundary.

questions.subject: Mathematics
questions.question: What is surface area?

options.A: The total area of the outer surfaces of a three-dimensional solid
options.B: The length of the boundary of a 2D figure
options.C: The space occupied by a solid
options.D: The area of only the curved surface

questions.explanation: Surface area is the total area of the outer surfaces of a three-dimensional solid.

questions.subject: Mathematics
questions.question: What is curved surface area (CSA)?

options.A: The area of all surfaces including bases
options.B: The area of only the curved surface of a solid, excluding flat bases
options.C: The area of the base only
options.D: The volume of the curved part

questions.explanation: CSA is the area of only the curved surface of a solid, excluding its flat base or bases.

questions.subject: Mathematics
questions.question: What is lateral surface area (LSA)?

options.A: The area of the top and bottom bases
options.B: The area of the side faces of a solid, excluding top and bottom bases
options.C: The area of only the curved part of a sphere
options.D: The total area of all surfaces

questions.explanation: LSA is the area of the side faces of a solid, excluding its top and bottom bases.

questions.subject: Mathematics
questions.question: What is total surface area (TSA)?

options.A: The area of only the curved surface
options.B: The area of only the side faces
options.C: The sum of the areas of all outer surfaces, including the bases

questions.explanation: TSA is the sum of the areas of all outer surfaces, including the bases.

questions.subject: Mathematics
questions.question: What is volume?

options.A: The total boundary length of a figure
options.C: The amount of three-dimensional space occupied by a solid
options.D: The area of the outer surface

questions.explanation: Volume is the amount of three-dimensional space occupied by a solid.

questions.subject: Mathematics
questions.question: What is the SI unit of length?
questions.explanation: The SI unit of length is the metre (m).

questions.subject: Mathematics
questions.question: What is the SI unit of area?
questions.explanation: The SI unit of area is the square metre (m²).

questions.subject: Mathematics
questions.question: What is the SI unit of volume?
questions.explanation: The SI unit of volume is the cubic metre (m³).

questions.subject: Mathematics
questions.question: What is the common unit of capacity for liquids?
questions.explanation: Capacity is commonly expressed in litres (L) or millilitres (mL), while volume is expressed in cubic units.

questions.subject: Mathematics
questions.question: How many centimetres are there in 1 metre?

questions.subject: Mathematics
questions.question: How many metres are there in 1 kilometre?

questions.subject: Mathematics
questions.question: 1 m² is equal to how many cm²?

questions.subject: Mathematics
questions.question: 1 km² is equal to how many m²?

questions.subject: Mathematics
questions.question: 1 m³ is equal to how many cm³?

questions.subject: Mathematics
questions.question: How many cubic centimetres are there in one litre?

questions.subject: Mathematics
questions.question: How many litres are there in one cubic metre?

questions.subject: Mathematics
questions.question: How many millilitres are there in one litre?

questions.subject: Mathematics
questions.question: Why must units be converted before applying mensuration formulas?

options.A: Because formulas require only SI units
options.B: Because all dimensions in a formula must be in compatible units; otherwise the numerical result will be incorrect
options.C: Because conversion changes the shape of the figure
options.D: Because conversion is optional and does not affect the result

questions.explanation: All dimensions in a formula must be expressed in compatible units; otherwise the numerical result will be incorrect.

questions.subject: Mathematics
questions.question: What is the difference between perimeter and area?

options.A: Perimeter measures surface in square units; area measures boundary in linear units
options.B: Perimeter measures boundary length in linear units; area measures enclosed surface in square units
options.D: Perimeter measures volume; area measures length

questions.explanation: Perimeter measures boundary length in linear units; area measures the enclosed surface in square units.

questions.subject: Mathematics
questions.question: What is the difference between area and volume?

options.A: Area measures 3D space; volume measures a 2D region
options.B: Area measures a two-dimensional region; volume measures three-dimensional space

questions.explanation: Area measures a two-dimensional region; volume measures three-dimensional space.

questions.subject: Mathematics
questions.question: What is the difference between CSA and TSA?

options.A: CSA includes only the curved surface; TSA includes every outer surface including flat bases
options.B: CSA includes all surfaces; TSA includes only curved surfaces
options.D: CSA measures volume; TSA measures length

questions.explanation: CSA includes only the curved surface; TSA includes every outer surface, including flat bases.

questions.subject: Mathematics
questions.question: What is the perimeter of a square of side a?
questions.explanation: The perimeter of a square is 4a.

questions.subject: Mathematics
questions.question: What is the perimeter of a rectangle of length l and breadth b?
questions.explanation: The perimeter of a rectangle is 2(l + b).

questions.subject: Mathematics
questions.question: What is the perimeter of a triangle with sides a, b and c?
questions.explanation: The perimeter of a triangle is a + b + c.

questions.subject: Mathematics
questions.question: What is the perimeter of an equilateral triangle of side a?
questions.explanation: The perimeter of an equilateral triangle is 3a.

questions.subject: Mathematics
questions.question: What is the perimeter of a parallelogram with adjacent sides a and b?
questions.explanation: The perimeter of a parallelogram is 2(a + b).

questions.subject: Mathematics
questions.question: What is the perimeter of a rhombus of side a?
questions.explanation: The perimeter of a rhombus of side a is 4a.

questions.subject: Mathematics
questions.question: What is the perimeter of a regular polygon with n sides, each of length a?
questions.explanation: The perimeter of a regular polygon with n sides each of length a is na.

questions.subject: Mathematics
questions.question: What is the circumference of a circle of radius r?
questions.explanation: The circumference of a circle is 2πr (or πd).

questions.subject: Mathematics
questions.question: What is the perimeter of a semicircle of radius r, including its diameter?
questions.explanation: The perimeter of a semicircle including its diameter is πr + 2r.

questions.subject: Mathematics
questions.question: What is the perimeter of a quadrant of radius r?
questions.explanation: The perimeter of a quadrant is two radii plus one-quarter of the circumference: 2r + πr/2.

questions.subject: Mathematics
questions.question: What is the perimeter of a sector of radius r and central angle θ degrees?
questions.explanation: The perimeter of a sector is 2r + (θ/360°) × 2πr.

questions.subject: Mathematics
questions.question: A square has side 8 cm. What is its perimeter?
questions.explanation: Perimeter = 4 × 8 = 32 cm.

questions.subject: Mathematics
questions.question: A rectangle is 12 cm long and 5 cm broad. What is its perimeter?
questions.explanation: Perimeter = 2(12 + 5) = 34 cm.

questions.subject: Mathematics
questions.question: A circle has radius 7 cm. What is its circumference using π = 22/7?
questions.explanation: Circumference = 2 × 22/7 × 7 = 44 cm.

questions.subject: Mathematics
questions.question: What is the area of a square of side a?
questions.explanation: The area of a square is a².

questions.subject: Mathematics
questions.question: What is the area of a rectangle of length l and breadth b?
questions.explanation: The area of a rectangle is length × breadth = lb.

questions.subject: Mathematics
questions.question: What is the area of a triangle with base b and perpendicular height h?
questions.explanation: The area of a triangle is (1/2) × base × height = (1/2)bh.

questions.subject: Mathematics
questions.question: What is the area of an equilateral triangle of side a?
questions.explanation: The area of an equilateral triangle is (√3/4)a².

questions.subject: Mathematics
questions.question: What is Heron's formula for the area of a triangle with sides a, b, c?
questions.explanation: Heron's formula: Area = √[s(s-a)(s-b)(s-c)], where s = (a+b+c)/2.

questions.subject: Mathematics
questions.question: What is the area of a parallelogram?
questions.explanation: The area of a parallelogram is base × perpendicular height = bh.

questions.subject: Mathematics
questions.question: What is the area of a rhombus using its diagonals d₁ and d₂?
questions.explanation: The area of a rhombus is (1/2) × d₁ × d₂.

questions.subject: Mathematics
questions.question: What is the area of a trapezium with parallel sides a and b and perpendicular height h?
questions.explanation: The area of a trapezium is (1/2)(a + b)h.

questions.subject: Mathematics
questions.question: What is the area of a circle of radius r?
questions.explanation: The area of a circle is πr².

questions.subject: Mathematics
questions.question: What is the area of a semicircle of radius r?
questions.explanation: The area of a semicircle is (1/2)πr².

questions.subject: Mathematics
questions.question: What is the area of a quadrant of radius r?
questions.explanation: The area of a quadrant is (1/4)πr².

questions.subject: Mathematics
questions.question: What is the area of a sector with central angle θ degrees and radius r?
questions.explanation: The area of a sector is (θ/360°) × πr².

questions.subject: Mathematics
questions.question: What is the area of a circular ring (annulus) with outer radius R and inner radius r?
questions.explanation: The area of an annulus is π(R² - r²).

questions.subject: Mathematics
questions.question: What is the area of a square of side 9 cm?
questions.explanation: Area = 9² = 81 cm².

questions.subject: Mathematics
questions.question: A triangle has base 14 cm and perpendicular height 6 cm. What is its area?

questions.subject: Mathematics
questions.question: A circle has radius 7 cm. What is its area using π = 22/7?

questions.subject: Mathematics
questions.question: What happens to the area of a square if its side is doubled?

options.A: It becomes double the original area
options.B: It becomes three times the original area
options.C: It becomes four times the original area

questions.explanation: If the side is doubled, area = (2a)² = 4a², i.e., four times the original area.

questions.subject: Mathematics
questions.question: What happens to the area of a circle if its radius is doubled?

options.A: It becomes double the original area
options.B: It becomes three times the original area
options.C: It becomes four times the original area
options.D: It becomes eight times the original area

questions.explanation: If the radius is doubled, area = π(2r)² = 4πr², i.e., four times the original area.

questions.subject: Mathematics
questions.question: What is a face of a solid?

options.A: A corner point where edges meet
options.B: A flat or curved surface forming part of the boundary of a 3D solid
options.C: A line segment where two faces meet

questions.explanation: A face is a flat or curved surface forming part of the boundary of a three-dimensional solid.

questions.subject: Mathematics
questions.question: What is an edge of a polyhedron?

options.C: A line segment where two flat faces meet

questions.explanation: An edge is a line segment where two flat faces meet.

questions.subject: Mathematics
questions.question: What is a vertex of a solid?

options.B: A line segment where faces meet
options.C: A corner point where edges meet

questions.explanation: A vertex is a corner point where edges meet.

questions.subject: Mathematics
questions.question: What is a polyhedron?

options.A: A solid with only curved surfaces
options.B: A 3D solid bounded entirely by flat polygonal faces
options.D: A solid with one circular base

questions.explanation: A polyhedron is a three-dimensional solid bounded entirely by flat polygonal faces.

questions.subject: Mathematics
questions.question: What is a regular polyhedron?

options.B: A polyhedron whose faces are congruent regular polygons and whose arrangement is the same at every vertex
options.C: A polyhedron with only triangular faces

questions.explanation: A regular polyhedron has congruent regular polygonal faces and the same arrangement at every vertex.

questions.subject: Mathematics
questions.question: What is a prism?

options.A: A solid with one circular base and an apex
options.B: A polyhedron with two congruent, parallel polygonal bases and parallelogram-shaped lateral faces

questions.explanation: A prism is a polyhedron with two congruent, parallel polygonal bases and parallelogram-shaped lateral faces; in a right prism, lateral faces are rectangles.

questions.subject: Mathematics
questions.question: What is a cylinder?

options.A: A solid with one circular base and an apex
options.B: A solid with two congruent, parallel circular bases joined by a curved surface
options.C: A solid with six square faces

questions.explanation: A cylinder has two congruent, parallel circular bases joined by a curved surface.

questions.subject: Mathematics
questions.question: What is a cone?

options.A: A solid with two circular bases
options.B: A solid with one circular base and a curved surface tapering to a single vertex called the apex
options.C: A solid with six rectangular faces

questions.explanation: A cone has one circular base and a curved surface tapering to a single vertex called the apex.

questions.subject: Mathematics
questions.question: What is a pyramid?

options.A: A polyhedron with one polygonal base and triangular side faces meeting at a common apex
options.B: A solid with two parallel circular bases
options.D: A solid with six square faces

questions.explanation: A pyramid is a polyhedron with one polygonal base and triangular side faces meeting at a common apex.

questions.subject: Mathematics
questions.question: What is a sphere?

options.A: A solid with two circular bases
options.B: A perfectly round 3D solid whose surface points are all at the same distance from its centre
options.D: A solid with one polygonal base

questions.explanation: A sphere is a perfectly round three-dimensional solid whose surface points are all at the same distance from its centre.

questions.subject: Mathematics
questions.question: What is a hemisphere?

options.B: Half of a sphere formed by a plane through its centre

questions.explanation: A hemisphere is half of a sphere formed by a plane through its centre.

questions.subject: Mathematics
questions.question: What is the radius of a sphere?

options.A: The distance across the sphere through the centre
options.B: The distance from its centre to any point on its surface
options.C: The surface area of the sphere

questions.explanation: The radius of a sphere is the distance from its centre to any point on its surface.

questions.subject: Mathematics
questions.question: What is the diameter of a sphere in terms of its radius?
questions.explanation: Diameter = 2 × radius.

questions.subject: Mathematics
questions.question: What is the height of a solid?

options.B: The perpendicular distance between its base and the opposite face or apex

questions.explanation: Height is the perpendicular distance between the base and the opposite face or apex, as appropriate.

questions.subject: Mathematics
questions.question: What is the slant height of a right circular cone?

options.A: The perpendicular height of the cone
options.B: The length along the sloping surface from the apex to the edge of the circular base

questions.explanation: The slant height is the length along the sloping surface from the apex to the edge of the circular base.

questions.subject: Mathematics
questions.question: What is the relation between cone radius r, vertical height h and slant height l?
questions.explanation: For a right circular cone, l² = r² + h², so l = √(r² + h²).

questions.subject: Mathematics
questions.question: What is a cube?

options.A: A solid with six equal square faces, twelve equal edges and eight vertices
options.B: A solid with six rectangular faces
options.C: A solid with two circular bases
options.D: A solid with one circular base and an apex

questions.explanation: A cube has six equal square faces, twelve equal edges and eight vertices.

questions.subject: Mathematics
questions.question: How many faces, edges and vertices does a cube have?
questions.explanation: A cube has 6 faces, 12 edges and 8 vertices.

questions.subject: Mathematics
questions.question: What is the total surface area of a cube of side a?
questions.explanation: TSA of a cube = 6a².

questions.subject: Mathematics
questions.question: What is the lateral surface area of a cube of side a?
questions.explanation: LSA of a cube = 4a².

questions.subject: Mathematics
questions.question: What is the volume of a cube of side a?
questions.explanation: Volume of a cube = a³.

questions.subject: Mathematics
questions.question: What is the length of the space diagonal of a cube of side a?
questions.explanation: The space diagonal of a cube = a√3.

questions.subject: Mathematics
questions.question: A cube has side 4 cm. What is its volume?
questions.explanation: Volume = 4³ = 64 cm³.

questions.subject: Mathematics
questions.question: Find the total surface area of a cube of side 5 cm.
questions.explanation: TSA = 6 × 5² = 150 cm².

questions.subject: Mathematics
questions.question: If the side of a cube is doubled, its volume becomes how many times the original volume?
questions.explanation: Volume = (2a)³ = 8a³, i.e., eight times the original volume.

questions.subject: Mathematics
questions.question: What is a cuboid?

options.A: A solid bounded by six rectangular faces; opposite faces are equal and parallel
options.B: A solid with six equal square faces
options.C: A solid with two circular bases

questions.explanation: A cuboid is a solid bounded by six rectangular faces; opposite faces are equal and parallel.

questions.subject: Mathematics
questions.question: How many faces, edges and vertices does a cuboid have?
questions.explanation: A cuboid has 6 faces, 12 edges and 8 vertices.

questions.subject: Mathematics
questions.question: What is the lateral surface area of a cuboid of length l, breadth b and height h?
questions.explanation: LSA of a cuboid = 2h(l + b).

questions.subject: Mathematics
questions.question: What is the total surface area of a cuboid of length l, breadth b and height h?
questions.explanation: TSA of a cuboid = 2(lb + bh + hl).

questions.subject: Mathematics
questions.question: What is the volume of a cuboid of length l, breadth b and height h?
questions.explanation: Volume of a cuboid = lbh.

questions.subject: Mathematics
questions.question: What is the length of the space diagonal of a cuboid of length l, breadth b and height h?
questions.explanation: The space diagonal of a cuboid = √(l² + b² + h²).

questions.subject: Mathematics
questions.question: A cuboid measures 5 cm × 4 cm × 3 cm. What is its volume?
questions.explanation: Volume = 5 × 4 × 3 = 60 cm³.

questions.subject: Mathematics
questions.question: A cuboid measures 5 cm × 4 cm × 3 cm. What is its total surface area?

questions.subject: Mathematics
questions.question: A cuboid measures 10 cm × 6 cm × 4 cm. Find its total surface area and volume.

questions.subject: Mathematics
questions.question: What is the curved surface area of a cylinder of radius r and height h?
questions.explanation: CSA of a cylinder = 2πrh.

questions.subject: Mathematics
questions.question: What is the total surface area of a closed cylinder of radius r and height h?
questions.explanation: TSA of a closed cylinder = 2πr(h + r), including both circular bases.

questions.subject: Mathematics
questions.question: What is the volume of a cylinder of radius r and height h?
questions.explanation: Volume of a cylinder = πr²h.

questions.subject: Mathematics
questions.question: What is the lateral surface area of a cylinder?
questions.explanation: The lateral surface area (LSA) of a cylinder is the same as its curved surface area, 2πrh.

questions.subject: Mathematics
questions.question: What is the total surface area of an open cylinder with one circular base?
questions.explanation: For an open cylinder with one circular base, TSA = curved surface area + one base = 2πrh + πr².

questions.subject: Mathematics
questions.question: When a cylinder is unrolled, its curved surface becomes what shape, and what is its area?

options.B: A rectangle of length equal to circumference 2πr and breadth h, area 2πrh
options.C: A circle of radius r, area πr²
options.D: A triangle of base 2πr and height h, area πrh

questions.explanation: When unrolled, the curved surface of a cylinder becomes a rectangle of length 2πr and breadth h, giving area 2πrh.

questions.question: A cylinder has radius 7 cm and height 10 cm. Find its curved surface area using π = 22/7.

questions.subject: Mathematics
questions.question: For a closed cylinder, which surfaces does the TSA include compared to an open cylinder with no bases?

options.A: Both include exactly the same surfaces
options.B: Closed TSA includes two circular bases in addition to the curved surface; open (no bases) includes only the curved surface
options.C: Closed TSA includes only the curved surface; open includes the bases
options.D: Closed TSA includes one base; open includes two bases

questions.explanation: A closed cylinder's TSA includes two circular bases plus the curved surface, while an open cylinder with no bases has only the curved surface.

questions.subject: Mathematics
questions.question: What is the curved surface area of a right circular cone of base radius r and slant height l?
questions.explanation: CSA of a cone = πrl, where l is the slant height.

questions.subject: Mathematics
questions.question: What is the total surface area of a closed right circular cone?
questions.explanation: TSA of a closed cone = πr(l + r), including its circular base.

questions.subject: Mathematics
questions.question: What is the volume of a cone of base radius r and perpendicular height h?
questions.explanation: Volume of a cone = (1/3)πr²h, where h is the perpendicular height.

questions.subject: Mathematics
questions.question: Why is the volume of a cone one-third the volume of a cylinder with the same base and height?

options.A: Because the cone's base is smaller
options.B: Because a cone occupies one-third of the volume of a cylinder having the same base area and perpendicular height
options.C: Because the cone's height is one-third
options.D: Because the cone has no base

questions.explanation: A cone occupies one-third of the volume of a cylinder having the same base area and perpendicular height.

questions.subject: Mathematics
questions.question: A cone has radius 3 cm and height 4 cm. What is its slant height?

questions.subject: Mathematics
questions.question: A cone has radius 3 cm and height 4 cm. What is its volume?
questions.explanation: Volume = (1/3) × π × 9 × 4 = 12π cm³.

questions.subject: Mathematics
questions.question: A cone has radius 7 cm and perpendicular height 24 cm. Find its slant height.

questions.subject: Mathematics
questions.question: The slant height of a cone with radius 5 cm and height 12 cm is:

questions.subject: Mathematics
questions.question: The volume of a cone with radius 3 cm and height 7 cm is:
questions.explanation: Volume = (1/3) × π × 3² × 7 = 21π cm³.

questions.subject: Mathematics
questions.question: For a cone, which height measure is used in the volume formula and which in the curved surface area formula?

options.B: Perpendicular (vertical) height h in volume; slant height l in curved surface area
options.D: Slant height in volume; perpendicular height in CSA

questions.explanation: Cone volume uses vertical height h, while curved surface area uses slant height l.

questions.subject: Mathematics
questions.question: What is the surface area of a sphere of radius r?
questions.explanation: Surface area of a sphere = 4πr².

questions.subject: Mathematics
questions.question: What is the volume of a sphere of radius r?
questions.explanation: Volume of a sphere = (4/3)πr³.

questions.subject: Mathematics
questions.question: A sphere has radius 3 cm. What is its volume?
questions.explanation: Volume = (4/3)π × 27 = 36π cm³.

questions.subject: Mathematics
questions.question: Find the surface area of a sphere of radius 7 cm using π = 22/7.
questions.explanation: Surface area = 4 × (22/7) × 49 = 616 cm².

questions.subject: Mathematics
questions.question: The surface area of a sphere of radius 5 cm is:
questions.explanation: Surface area = 4πr² = 4 × π × 25 = 100π cm².

questions.subject: Mathematics
questions.question: Does a sphere have a separate curved/flat surface distinction?

options.A: Yes, its top half is curved and bottom half is flat
options.B: No, a sphere has no separate curved/flat surface distinction; its surface area is 4πr²
options.C: Yes, the base of a sphere is flat
options.D: Yes, a sphere has two flat circular faces

questions.explanation: A sphere has no separate curved/flat surface distinction; its surface area is 4πr².

questions.subject: Mathematics
questions.question: What is the curved surface area of a hemisphere of radius r?
questions.explanation: CSA of a hemisphere = 2πr².

questions.subject: Mathematics
questions.question: What is the total surface area of a solid hemisphere of radius r, including its circular base?
questions.explanation: TSA of a solid hemisphere = 3πr², including its circular base.

questions.subject: Mathematics
questions.question: What is the volume of a hemisphere of radius r?
questions.explanation: Volume of a hemisphere = (2/3)πr³.

questions.subject: Mathematics
questions.question: A hemisphere has radius 7 cm. What is its total surface area using π = 22/7?

questions.subject: Mathematics
questions.question: The volume of a hemisphere of radius 3 cm is:
questions.explanation: Volume = (2/3)π × 27 = 18π cm³.

questions.subject: Mathematics
questions.question: For a solid hemisphere, how do TSA and CSA differ?

options.A: TSA includes the circular base; CSA does not
options.B: CSA includes the circular base; TSA does not

questions.explanation: For a solid hemisphere, TSA includes the circular base (3πr²) whereas CSA does not (2πr²).

questions.subject: Mathematics
questions.question: What is the total surface area of a hollow hemisphere open at its circular base, if thickness and inner surface are specified?

options.A: Only the outer curved surface area 2πr²
options.B: Both curved surfaces (outer and inner) must be considered if thickness and inner surface are specified

questions.explanation: Its outer curved surface area is 2πr²; if thickness and inner surface are specified, both curved surfaces must be considered.

questions.subject: Mathematics
questions.question: What is the volume of any prism?

options.B: Area of its base × perpendicular height

questions.explanation: Volume of a prism = base area × perpendicular height (distance between the bases).

questions.subject: Mathematics
questions.question: What is the lateral surface area of a right prism?
questions.explanation: LSA of a right prism = perimeter of the base × height.

questions.subject: Mathematics
questions.question: What is the total surface area of a right prism?
questions.explanation: TSA of a right prism = lateral surface area + 2 × base area.

questions.subject: Mathematics
questions.question: What is the volume of a pyramid?
questions.explanation: Volume of a pyramid = (1/3) × base area × perpendicular height.

questions.subject: Mathematics
questions.question: What is the lateral surface area of a regular pyramid?
questions.explanation: LSA of a regular pyramid = (1/2) × perimeter of base × slant height.

questions.subject: Mathematics
questions.question: What is the total surface area of a pyramid?
questions.explanation: TSA of a pyramid = base area + lateral surface area.

questions.subject: Mathematics
questions.question: What is a composite figure?

options.A: A figure made by combining two or more basic geometric shapes
options.B: A figure with only one shape

questions.explanation: A composite figure is made by combining two or more basic geometric shapes.

questions.subject: Mathematics
questions.question: How is the area of a composite plane figure calculated?

options.A: By using a single formula for the whole figure
options.B: Divide it into familiar shapes, calculate each area, and add them; subtract any cut-out or missing regions

questions.explanation: Divide the composite figure into familiar shapes, calculate each area, and add them; subtract any cut-out or missing regions.

questions.subject: Mathematics
questions.question: How is the volume of a composite solid calculated?

options.A: By using the formula of the largest component only
options.B: Divide it into simple solids, calculate their volumes, and add or subtract volumes as required
options.C: By finding the total surface area

questions.explanation: Divide the composite solid into simple solids, calculate their volumes, and add or subtract volumes as required.

questions.subject: Mathematics
questions.question: How is the cost of fencing a rectangular field calculated?

options.A: Area × fencing cost per unit area
options.B: Perimeter × fencing cost per unit length, after accounting for gates or openings if specified
options.C: Volume × fencing cost per unit volume
options.D: Diagonal × fencing cost per unit length

questions.explanation: Cost of fencing = perimeter × fencing cost per unit length, after accounting for gates or openings if specified.

questions.subject: Mathematics
questions.question: How is the cost of painting the walls of a room calculated?

options.A: Floor area × cost per unit area
options.B: Total wall area to be painted × cost per unit area, subtracting doors and windows if the question requires it
options.C: Volume of the room × cost per unit volume
options.D: Perimeter of the floor × cost per unit length

questions.explanation: Cost of painting walls = total wall area to be painted × cost per unit area, subtracting doors and windows if required.

questions.subject: Mathematics
questions.question: How is the cost of painting a solid object calculated?

options.A: Relevant exposed surface area × painting cost per unit area; do not include surfaces that are not painted
options.B: Volume × painting cost per unit volume
options.C: Total mass × painting cost per unit mass
options.D: Height × painting cost per unit height

questions.explanation: Cost of painting a solid = relevant exposed surface area × painting cost per unit area; exclude surfaces not painted.

questions.subject: Mathematics
questions.question: How is the capacity of a tank calculated?

options.A: Calculate its external surface area and convert to litres
options.B: Calculate its internal volume and convert the cubic units into litres or another required capacity unit
options.C: Calculate its perimeter and convert to litres

questions.explanation: Capacity of a tank = internal volume converted into litres or another required capacity unit.

questions.subject: Mathematics
questions.question: How much water can a rectangular tank hold?

options.A: Its external length × external breadth × external height
options.B: Its internal length × internal breadth × internal height, expressed as volume; convert to litres if required

questions.explanation: A rectangular tank holds its internal length × internal breadth × internal height, expressed as volume; convert to litres if required.

questions.subject: Mathematics
questions.question: What is displacement in mensuration problems?

options.A: The surface area of an immersed object
options.B: The volume of liquid displaced by an immersed object; for a fully submerged object, it equals the object's volume
options.D: The height of the liquid before immersion

questions.explanation: Displacement is the volume of liquid displaced by an immersed object; for a fully submerged object, it equals the object's volume.

questions.subject: Mathematics
questions.question: How is the material needed to make a closed box estimated in a basic problem?

options.B: Use its total surface area, subject to allowances for seams, overlaps or wastage if stated

questions.explanation: Material for a closed box is estimated using its total surface area, subject to allowances for seams, overlaps or wastage if stated.

questions.subject: Mathematics
questions.question: How is the material needed to make an open-top box calculated?

options.A: Use the total surface area including the top
options.B: Add the base area and the areas of the side faces; exclude the missing top
options.D: Use the volume of the box

questions.explanation: For an open-top box, add the base area and the areas of the side faces; exclude the missing top.

questions.subject: Mathematics
questions.question: How is the volume of a solid melted and recast into smaller solids handled?

options.B: Assuming no material is lost, total original volume equals the sum of the volumes of the recast solids
options.C: The volume of the new solids is always greater

questions.explanation: Assuming no material is lost, total original volume equals the sum of the volumes of the recast solids.

questions.subject: Mathematics
questions.question: How many small cubes of side a can be made from a cube of side L, with no wastage and exact fitting?

options.B: (L/a)³, provided L/a is a whole number

questions.explanation: Number of small cubes = (L/a)³, provided L/a is a whole number, with no wastage and exact fitting.

questions.subject: Mathematics
questions.question: What is the relation between the volume of a cylinder and a cone with the same base radius and height?

options.A: The cone's volume is equal to the cylinder's volume
options.B: The cone's volume is one-third of the cylinder's volume
options.C: The cone's volume is twice the cylinder's volume
options.D: The cone's volume is half the cylinder's volume

questions.explanation: The cone's volume is one-third of the cylinder's volume when they have the same base radius and height.

questions.subject: Mathematics
questions.question: In the consolidated formula sheet, what is the formula for the perimeter of a square?
questions.explanation: Square: P = 4a; A = a².

questions.subject: Mathematics
questions.question: In the consolidated formula sheet, what is the formula for the area of a rectangle?
questions.explanation: Rectangle: P = 2(l + b); A = lb.

questions.subject: Mathematics
questions.question: In the consolidated formula sheet, the perimeter of a triangle with sides a, b, c is:
questions.explanation: Triangle: P = a + b + c.

questions.subject: Mathematics
questions.question: In the consolidated formula sheet, the area of an equilateral triangle is:
questions.explanation: Equilateral triangle: A = (√3/4)a².

questions.subject: Mathematics
questions.question: In the consolidated formula sheet, the perimeter of a parallelogram with adjacent sides a and b is:
questions.explanation: Parallelogram: P = 2(a + b); A = bh.

questions.subject: Mathematics
questions.question: In the consolidated formula sheet, the area of a rhombus or kite using diagonals d₁ and d₂ is:
questions.explanation: Rhombus/kite: A = (1/2) × d₁ × d₂.

questions.subject: Mathematics
questions.question: In the consolidated formula sheet, the area of a trapezium with parallel sides a and b and height h is:
questions.explanation: Trapezium: A = (1/2)(a + b)h.

questions.subject: Mathematics
questions.question: In the consolidated formula sheet, the circumference of a circle is:
questions.explanation: Circle: C = 2πr = πd; A = πr².

questions.subject: Mathematics
questions.question: In the consolidated formula sheet, the area of a semicircle is:
questions.explanation: Semicircle: A = (1/2)πr²; perimeter including diameter = πr + 2r.

questions.subject: Mathematics
questions.question: In the consolidated formula sheet, the arc length of a sector with central angle θ is:
questions.explanation: Sector: arc length = (θ/360°) × 2πr; area = (θ/360°) × πr².

questions.subject: Mathematics
questions.question: In the consolidated formula sheet, the volume of a cube is:
questions.explanation: Cube: LSA = 4a²; TSA = 6a²; V = a³; diagonal = a√3.

questions.subject: Mathematics
questions.question: In the consolidated formula sheet, the diagonal of a cube of side a is:
questions.explanation: Cube: diagonal = a√3.

questions.subject: Mathematics
questions.question: In the consolidated formula sheet, the TSA of a cuboid is:
questions.explanation: Cuboid: LSA = 2h(l + b); TSA = 2(lb + bh + hl); V = lbh.

questions.subject: Mathematics
questions.question: In the consolidated formula sheet, the volume of a cylinder is:
questions.explanation: Cylinder: CSA = 2πrh; closed TSA = 2πr(h + r); V = πr²h.

questions.subject: Mathematics
questions.question: In the consolidated formula sheet, the closed TSA of a cone is:
questions.explanation: Cone: CSA = πrl; closed TSA = πr(l + r); V = (1/3)πr²h; l² = r² + h².

questions.subject: Mathematics
questions.question: In the consolidated formula sheet, the surface area of a sphere is:
questions.explanation: Sphere: surface area = 4πr²; V = (4/3)πr³.

questions.subject: Mathematics
questions.question: In the consolidated formula sheet, the TSA of a hemisphere is:
questions.explanation: Hemisphere: CSA = 2πr²; TSA = 3πr²; V = (2/3)πr³.

questions.subject: Mathematics
questions.question: In the consolidated formula sheet, the volume of a prism is:

options.A: Base area × height; right-prism LSA = base perimeter × height

questions.explanation: Prism: V = base area × height; right-prism LSA = base perimeter × height.

questions.subject: Mathematics
questions.question: In the consolidated formula sheet, the volume of a pyramid is:

options.B: (1/3) × base area × height; regular-pyramid LSA = (1/2) × base perimeter × slant height

questions.explanation: Pyramid: V = (1/3) × base area × height; regular-pyramid LSA = (1/2) × base perimeter × slant height.

questions.subject: Mathematics
questions.question: According to the consolidated formula sheet, 1 m² = ?
questions.explanation: Conversions: 1 m² = 10,000 cm².

questions.subject: Mathematics
questions.question: According to the consolidated formula sheet, 1 m³ = ?
questions.explanation: Conversions: 1 m³ = 1,000,000 cm³.

questions.subject: Mathematics
questions.question: According to the consolidated formula sheet, 1 L = ?
questions.explanation: Conversions: 1 L = 1,000 cm³.

questions.subject: Mathematics
questions.question: According to the consolidated formula sheet, 1 m³ = ?
questions.explanation: Conversions: 1 m³ = 1,000 L.

questions.subject: Mathematics
questions.question: A rectangle is 15 m long and 8 m wide. Find its perimeter and area.
questions.explanation: Perimeter = 2(15 + 8) = 46 m; Area = 15 × 8 = 120 m².

questions.subject: Mathematics
questions.question: A triangle has base 18 cm and perpendicular height 10 cm. Find its area.

questions.subject: Mathematics
questions.question: Find the circumference and area of a circle of radius 14 cm using π = 22/7.
questions.explanation: Circumference = 2 × (22/7) × 14 = 88 cm; Area = (22/7) × 14² = 616 cm².

questions.subject: Mathematics
questions.question: Find the total surface area and volume of a cube of side 5 cm.
questions.explanation: TSA = 6 × 25 = 150 cm²; Volume = 5³ = 125 cm³.

questions.subject: Mathematics
questions.question: A cuboid measures 10 cm × 6 cm × 4 cm. Find its total surface area and volume.

questions.subject: Mathematics
questions.question: A cylinder has radius 7 cm and height 5 cm. Find its volume using π = 22/7.

questions.subject: Mathematics
questions.question: A cone has radius 7 cm and perpendicular height 24 cm. Find its slant height.

questions.subject: Mathematics
questions.question: Find the surface area of a sphere of radius 7 cm using π = 22/7.
questions.explanation: Surface area = 4 × (22/7) × 49 = 616 cm².

questions.subject: Mathematics
questions.question: A metal cube of side 6 cm is melted into smaller cubes of side 2 cm. How many small cubes are formed?
questions.explanation: Number = 6³/2³ = 216/8 = 27 cubes, assuming no material is lost.

questions.subject: Mathematics
questions.question: A capacity conversion example in the notes shows 3,000 L converted to cubic metres. What is the result?

questions.subject: Mathematics
questions.question: What must be done before substituting dimensions into a mensuration formula?

options.A: Convert all dimensions into the same unit
options.C: Round all dimensions to the nearest whole number
options.D: Convert all dimensions to cubic units

questions.explanation: Convert all dimensions into the same unit before substituting into a formula.

questions.subject: Mathematics
questions.question: When calculating the area of a triangle, which height must be used?

options.B: The perpendicular height, not a sloping side

questions.explanation: For a triangle, use perpendicular height, not a sloping side.

questions.subject: Mathematics
questions.question: For a cylinder, what is the key distinction to check?

options.A: Whether to use radius or diameter
options.B: Whether curved surface area or total surface area is asked
options.C: Whether to use height or slant height
options.D: Whether the cylinder is open or closed at the top only

questions.explanation: For a cylinder, distinguish curved surface area from total surface area.

questions.subject: Mathematics
questions.question: How many circular bases does the TSA of a closed cylinder include, compared to an open cylinder?

options.A: Closed cylinder TSA includes two circular bases; an open cylinder may have one or no base
options.B: Closed cylinder TSA includes one base; an open cylinder always has two bases

questions.explanation: For a closed cylinder, TSA includes two circular bases; an open cylinder may have one or no base.

questions.subject: Mathematics
questions.question: For a cone, which height is used in the volume formula and which in the curved surface area formula?

options.A: Volume uses slant height; CSA uses vertical height
options.B: Volume uses vertical height h; CSA uses slant height l

questions.explanation: For a cone, volume uses vertical height h, while curved surface area uses slant height l.

questions.subject: Mathematics
questions.question: For a solid hemisphere, does the TSA include the circular base?

options.A: Yes, TSA includes the circular base; CSA does not
options.B: No, TSA excludes the circular base
options.C: Both TSA and CSA include the base
options.D: Both TSA and CSA exclude the base

questions.explanation: For a solid hemisphere, TSA includes the circular base; CSA does not.

questions.subject: Mathematics
questions.question: For a semicircle's perimeter, what must be included besides the curved arc?
questions.explanation: For a semicircle's perimeter, include the diameter; the curved arc alone is πr.

questions.subject: Mathematics
questions.question: Which dimensions should be used when calculating tank capacity?

options.C: Average of internal and external dimensions

questions.explanation: Use internal dimensions when calculating tank capacity.

questions.subject: Mathematics
questions.question: When calculating painting or covering costs, which surfaces should be included?

options.B: Only the surfaces actually exposed or specified

questions.explanation: For painting or covering, include only the surfaces actually exposed or specified.

questions.subject: Mathematics
questions.question: When an object is melted and recast without loss, which quantity is conserved?
questions.explanation: When an object is melted and recast without loss, conserve volume, not surface area.

questions.subject: Mathematics
questions.question: Which value of π should be used in a problem?

options.B: The value specified by the question; otherwise 22/7 or 3.14 may be used when appropriate

questions.explanation: Use the value of π specified by the question; otherwise 22/7 or 3.14 may be used when appropriate.

questions.subject: Mathematics
questions.question: What is the relation between radius and diameter?
questions.explanation: Do not confuse radius and diameter: d = 2r.

questions.subject: Mathematics
questions.question: Before selecting a formula, what should be checked in the question?

options.A: Whether the question asks for LSA, CSA, TSA, area or volume
options.B: Whether the question is from a particular chapter
options.D: Whether the figure is 2D or 3D only

questions.explanation: Check whether the question asks for LSA, CSA, TSA, area or volume before selecting a formula.
